articles.summary: Third Quarter Highlights: Sales were an all-time quarterly record of $818 million, an increase of 10% year-over-year Earnings per diluted share were a record $2.73, up 23% year-over-year Adjusted earnings per diluted share were $3.25, also a quarterly record and up 19% year-over-year Continued strength in demand with backlog up 35% compared to prior year Increasing full year guidance for sales and earnings Nordson Corporation (Nasdaq: NDSN) today reported results for the fiscal third quarter end
articles.title: Nordson Corporation Reports Record Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results and Increases Full Year Guidance
